Name: Jonathan, Son of Shage
Summary: Son of Shage the Hararite, one of David's mighty men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:34: Son of Shage the Hararite, one of David's mighty men.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jonathan stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
